summary: Frontend-only verification of the re-implemented /freelancer/jobs category/subcategory filter UX. All 7 scenarios from the review request passed on mobile viewport (390x844): (1) category-chip-row shows ALL + all 9 catalog categories with old CREATIVE/TECH/MARKETING/OPS chips fully removed; (2) GRAPHICS & DESIGN selection shows subcategory-chip-row with 16 services and feed narrows to 45 design jobs; (3) tapping subcat-chip-logo-design fills search with 'Logo Design' and relaxed word-fallback returns 5 logo-related gigs including 'Need logo designer urgently'; (3b) tapping the active subchip again clears the search input but keeps GRAPHICS & DESIGN active (count returns to 45); (4) switching from Graphics to PROGRAMMING & TECH auto-clears the subcategory-driven search and renders 16 tech subcategories (Website Development, Mobile App Development…); (5) ALL restores full 201-job feed and hides the subcategory row; (6) typing 'seo' still narrows the feed to 8 SEO-related gigs and the clear button restores 201; (7) MUSIC & AUDIO shows a subcategory row (11 chips) plus a clean empty-state (no crash). No functional bugs found in the filter change.

issues: 'JOBS NEAR YOU' title wraps to 5 stacked lines on 390px viewport because 4 icon buttons + UNVERIFIED badge crowd the header; pre-existing, unrelated to filter fix but visibly ugly on the screenshot the user sent. Consider hiding the subtitle on narrow screens or truncating the title.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Emitted by a third-party dependency (likely react-navigation/gesture-handler) on every load of /freelancer/jobs. Non-blocking but should be tracked when those libraries are bumped.

Console error: 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop.' Emitted repeatedly on load. Non-blocking but signals a peer dep hasn't caught up with React 19; verify @gorhom/bottom-sheet and @expo/vector-icons versions.

action_items: (Optional polish, unrelated to this bug) tighten the /freelancer/jobs top bar so 'JOBS NEAR YOU' doesn't wrap into 5 lines on 390px — hide the '201 active gigs · 2km radius' subtitle when width<400, or shrink icon buttons.
(Non-blocking) audit console warnings on jobs screen (pointerEvents deprecation, React 19 ref removal) when bumping @gorhom/bottom-sheet / gesture-handler / vector-icons.
critical_code_review_comments: jobs.tsx is 1261 lines — approaching the 700-line soft cap. Extract JobCard, the two chip rows, and the Apply/Paywall sheets into their own components in a future refactor.

CATEGORY_FILTERS.cats is a hand-maintained mapping duplicated against GET /api/catalog subcategories; when the catalog is edited the feed-filter buckets can silently drift. Consider deriving cats from the catalog response instead of hardcoding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Filter UX on /freelancer/jobs is fully working: category-chip-row renders 10 chips (cat-chip-all + cat-chip-{graphics-design,programming-tech,digital-marketing,writing-translation,video-animation,ai-services,music-audio,business,consulting}); when a non-ALL category is picked, subcategory-chip-row appears with subcat-chip-<slug> chips derived from GET /api/catalog. Relaxed word fallback confirmed working (Logo Design→'logo' matches). Do not retest UPI/Razorpay per iteration_11 handoff (merchant entitlement blocker).
rca_of_issue: N/A — verification pass, no bug found. The re-implementation in /app/frontend/app/freelancer/jobs.tsx correctly (a) hardcodes all 9 catalog categories in CATEGORY_FILTERS so none are hidden, (b) pulls subcategories dynamically from /api/catalog and renders a second chip row keyed on catFilter, (c) fills the search input with the subcategory label and clears it on second tap, (d) clears the subcategory-driven search when switching category (via allSubcatNames Set check), and (e) applies a relaxed word-split fallback when exact-phrase match yields 0 results.
